gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-adlam: Junegull is retro and friendly, with a pinched gap at each curve's mouth. Noto Sans Adlam, a plain sans with curve endings held well apart, gives those tight, closed shapes some breathing room beside them.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-adlam-u: Junegull has a pinched gap at the mouth of every curve and a lowercase as tall as cast iron capitals. Noto Sans Adlam Unjoined is a sans whose open curves make the difference.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-anatoli: Noto Sans Anatolian Hieroglyphs points its terminals outward and lifts its x-height nearly up to cap height. Junegull above it has stroke ends that look cut from one ribbon.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-arabic: Noto Sans Arabic reads clean, with generous openings in its small letters. Junegull, the display voice up top, shows no contrast between stems and joins, so the heading and text sit together easily.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-armenia: Junegull builds its letters from a single stroke width, with a pinched gap at the mouth of each curve. Noto Sans Armenian, a plain sans with tall, full c, s and z, opens up beneath it.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-avestan: Junegull gives r, n and m arches as sturdy as their stems, and pinches a gap into each curve. Noto Sans Avestan is a sans-serif whose curve tips never touch.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-balines: Curves that never thin at the shoulders give Junegull its friendly, retro look at display size. And Noto Sans Balinese does the quiet work, giving every curved glyph breathing space under short ascenders.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-bamum: Curved strokes that stop before turning inward keep the text light, a relief after the closed letters of Junegull. Noto Sans Bamum, a plain sans, stays open and clear paragraph after paragraph.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-bassa-v: Noto Sans Bassa Vah, a plain sans, lets its midsection swallow the line and gives its c pliers-like jaws. Junegull, drawn like a stencil-cut channel of constant weight, stays solid above it.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-batak: Stroke modulation of zero gives Junegull its retro, friendly charm. Noto Sans Batak, a sans-serif with towering x-height and an e that never squeezes shut, lends the whole pairing its footing.
